description: One run of the Docker lab (lab/compose.yaml, scripts/lab.js): OpenSSH 10.0 and rsyslog on Debian 13, RFC 3339 timestamps. Lab clock set to about 10:00, so no login falls in the unusual-hour window.

incidents.notes: 10 wrong guesses (2 root, 8 deploy), the right password, then sudo useradd -G sudo sysupdate from the same session.
20 guesses at root and common service accounts, four connections at a time. Never logs in.

bob mistypes once, then logs in (low). dave's key login 2 s later from the same workstation also counts, because the rule looks at failures from the IP for any username: a known false positive for shared source IPs, kept at low severity. dave creates erin (low) and adds her to sudo (medium); bob joining docker is ignored.
